db-bench-press: Feet planted. Lower deep, press up and slightly in.
incline-db-press: 30° bench. Deep stretch at the bottom, drive up.
low-to-high-cable-fly: Pulleys low. Sweep the hands up and together to chin height.
machine-chest-press: Handles at mid-chest. Press out, control the way back.
band-assisted-pull-ups: Band under the knees or feet. Full hang, chin over the bar.
chest-supported-db-row: Chest on the bench. Pull to the hips, pause and squeeze at the top.
close-grip-lat-pulldown: Neutral handle. Full stretch at the top, elbows to ribs.
pull-ups: Strict: full hang, chin over the bar. Crisp reps, never grinding.
single-arm-cable-row: Stretch forward, then pull the elbow to the hip.
straight-arm-pulldown: Arms straight, slight hinge. Sweep the bar to the thighs.
weighted-pull-ups: Dip belt. Full hang, chin over the bar.
cable-lateral-raise: Cable behind the body. Lead with the elbow to shoulder height.
db-lateral-raise: Lead with the elbows to shoulder height. No swing.
face-pulls: Rope to the eyebrows, elbows high, pull the ends apart.
machine-shoulder-press: Back supported. Two seconds down, stop just above the shoulders.
reverse-pec-deck: Chest on the pad. Sweep back to the sides, squeeze the rear delts.
seated-db-shoulder-press: Back on the bench, no arching. Lower to ear level, press up.
bayesian-cable-curl: Face away from a low cable, arm behind the body. Curl from the stretch.
cable-curl: Elbows pinned, stand tall. Curl to the chest, lower slowly.
hammer-curl: Thumbs up, elbows at the sides. No swing.
incline-db-curl: 45° bench, arms hang behind the body. Slow 3-second lower.
preacher-curl: Armpits on the pad. Full stretch at the bottom, no bounce.
ez-bar-skull-crusher: Lower behind the head for more stretch. Elbows stay in.
overhead-cable-extension: Face away from a low pulley. Elbows by the ears, stretch, extend.
rope-pushdown: Elbows pinned to the ribs. Spread the rope at the bottom.
ab-wheel-rollout: From the knees. Brace hard, stop before the back arches.
bicycle-crunch: Slow. Opposite elbow to knee, other leg long.
bird-dog: Reach the opposite arm and leg long. Pause 2 sec, hips level.
bird-dog-plank: From a high plank, lift the opposite arm and leg. No twist.
cable-crunch: Kneel, rope by the ears. Crunch down, rounding the upper spine.
dead-bug: Low back pressed down. Reach the opposite arm and leg out, switch.
hanging-knee-to-elbow-twist: Hang still. Knees up and across toward the opposite elbow.
hanging-leg-raise: No swinging. Raise the legs, curl the pelvis toward the ribs.
hollow-body-hold: Low back flat, arms overhead, legs low. Bend the knees if it lifts.
l-sit: Shoulders pushed down, legs level. Tuck the knees if you must.
pallof-press: Stand side-on. Press straight out and back, resist the twist.
plank: Forearms down, plate on the upper back. Glutes tight, no sag.
russian-twist: Lean back 45°, feet up, plate at the chest. Rotate slowly.
side-plank-with-reach: Side plank. Reach the top arm under and through, then to the ceiling.
suitcase-carry: One heavy DB at one side. Walk tall without leaning, then switch.
superman-hold: Face down. Lift arms and legs a little, hold 3 sec. Look at the floor.
toe-touches: Legs straight up. Reach for the toes, shoulders off the floor.
glute-bridge: On your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes 3 sec at the top.
hip-thrust: Upper back on the bench. Pause 2 sec at the top, chin tucked.
bulgarian-split-squat: Rear foot on the bench. Upright torso, drop straight down.
leg-extension: Sit back, pad on the shins. Squeeze 1 sec at the top.
leg-press: Feet mid-plate. Stop before the hips lift off the pad.
lying-hamstring-curl: Hips pressed down. Curl up, 3-second lower.
standing-calf-raise: Full stretch at the bottom, 2-sec pause, rise high.
copenhagen-plank: Top leg on the bench, side plank on the forearm. Hips high.
